_note: The research decisions and the presentation of the lines page, by line. tools/lines.py reads this with people.json, dossiers.json, living.json, trees.json and register.json and writes lines.json; it REFUSES a status that disagrees with trees.json `origins` (the archive's own statement of how each line begins), so no status here is stronger than what /trees/ already says. Notes are those origin statements, shortened to fit the lane's status line (100 characters with the span in front). A node is a dated place the archive's own origin statement names, with the person who is there; a line with none draws its spine and its people only. 25 October 2026.
